verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded Fuller, china-bolts, ITA live (200); globalfastener detail_2984 returns 403 live (tried plain and with Referer) so I parsed the producer's saved copy raw/ms-slot/gf_2984.html (title 'ISO 1207 - 2011 Slotted Cheese Head Screws'). Parsed all four into M-size dicts and compared the full record, 10 rows x 9 value columns = 90 cells, against each source: 0 disagreements, all 4 sites agree on all 90 cells; clusters (Fuller+gf merged, ITA merged with fasteners.eu) = exactly 3 on every cell. ITA table is the 2nd table on a page headed 'Table according to ISO 1207' (1st table = ISO 1580 pan head, page title wrongly says DIN 84 & 85); ITA table contains #NAME?/#REF! spreadsheet error cells that shift columns - I removed them before aligning. Also fetched fasteners.eu ISO 1207 / DIN 84 / ISO 1580: ISO 1207 and DIN 84 tables identical to the record (and to each other); ISO 1580 table differs from cheese (M3 dk 5.6 k 1.8, M6 dk 12 k 3.6, M10 dk 20 k 6). Sanity: dk_max>dk_min, k_max>k_min, n_max>n_min, t_min<k_min, all columns non-decreasing, dk_max = nominal head diameter 3.0..16, P = ISO coarse pitches 0.35..1.5.
problems: LABEL: family 'ms-slot' = '일자 홈 작은나사 (치즈·냄비·접시)', enStd ISO 1207 · 1580 · 2009 · 2010 · KS B 1021. The table is ISO 1207 CHEESE head only; pan (ISO 1580) and countersunk heads have different dk/k/t (e.g. M3 dk 5.5 k 2.0 cheese vs dk 5.6 k 1.8 pan; M6 dk 10 k 3.9 vs dk 12 k 3.6; M10 dk 16 k 6.0 vs 20/6.0). The family label therefore cannot honestly carry this table. Publish only if the item is relabelled to '일자 홈 치즈머리 작은나사 (ISO 1207)' and the column labels carry 치즈머리; under the 3-head label it must not be published (-> reject).

Exactly 3 clusters on every one of the 90 cells; the count depends on china-bolts being independent of Fuller/globalfastener (judged independent: different layout/transposed, includes da, no shared typo; not in any known copy cluster) - if china-bolts were merged into the Chinese-template cluster, every cell falls to 2 and the record is rejected.

Producer's third source ITA is not independent of fasteners.eu (copy); the cluster itself survives because fasteners.eu carries the same numbers, but it must be cited as fasteners.eu (+ITA mirror), not as a separate site.
